items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.why_read: Separate model parameters from a retrievable evidence collection.
items.implementation_boundary: The source register and bounded capsule are explicit non-parametric context. This reference does not implement the paper’s trained retriever.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
items.why_read: Evidence placement can affect retrieval from a long prompt.
items.implementation_boundary: Bounded context and source selection need positional stress tests; shorter context alone is not an answer-quality metric.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
items.why_read: Evaluate fluency, correctness and citation quality separately.
items.implementation_boundary: generation.py checks reference integrity. It does not implement the paper’s entailment or full citation-quality evaluator.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Measuring Attribution in Natural Language Generation Models
items.why_read: Attribution must be checked against an identified source.
items.implementation_boundary: The workbench exposes each source passage for review; a valid evidence ID does not prove the associated paraphrase.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
items.why_read: A long answer can mix supported and unsupported claims.
items.implementation_boundary: The draft uses individual cited items. No FActScore model judge or calibrated factuality score is claimed.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Ragas: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
items.why_read: Retrieval and generation require distinct evaluation dimensions.
items.implementation_boundary: Usage, reference checks and proposed domain rubrics are separate. This code does not run Ragas.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.why_read: Interleave model decisions with task-specific evidence access.
items.implementation_boundary: agent.py allows inspect_evidence and draft under a finite step budget. It records actions, not hidden chain of thought, and does not reproduce the ReAct benchmark.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
items.why_read: Retrieval and reflection can be made conditional on the task.
items.implementation_boundary: A learned reflection policy is a research option, not implemented by the current fixed tool contract.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
items.why_read: Global corpus questions differ from retrieving one supporting passage.
items.implementation_boundary: The present graph preserves provenance; it does not implement GraphRAG community summaries or establish corpus-wide completeness.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
items.why_read: Knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval can support multi-hop questions.
items.implementation_boundary: Graph retrieval is an experimental extension. The local reference uses an authored semantic layer, not Personalized PageRank.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
items.why_read: Multiple levels of summarization can support document retrieval.
items.implementation_boundary: Candidate research for large corpora. Summaries would need their own source lineage; no recursive summarizer is implemented here.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.

items.title: Attribution, Citation, and Quotation: A Survey of Evidence-based Text Generation with Large Language Models
items.why_read: Treat attribution, citation and quotation as distinct evidence operations.
items.implementation_boundary: The workflow separates exact quoted evidence, citation identity checks and an unverified model paraphrase.
items.review_scope: Primary landing page and abstract; not a replication or exhaustive paper review.
items.rights: Citation metadata and authored notes only; paper rights remain with authors/publisher.
